{{Quote|When the Emperor was still ruling there was no doubt about how things were to be done. Now&hellip; the people nowadays have stopped thinking because sloppiness no longer earns the sorts of rewards it did before.|The Imperial technician|<ref name="WG" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Imperial technician''' worked at a [[Unidentified manufacturing plant|manufacturing plant]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. In one of the plant's warehouses, he was met by undercover agents of the [[Alien Combine]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], who were trying to slip him rigged [[Memory bank/Legends|memory cores]] to be inserted into the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] central [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system. Having been tipped off, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] arrived and began [[Lightfight|firing]] at their enemies, and [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] shoved the [[Technician/Legends|technician]] out of his way while escaping.<ref name="WG" />
